weakest_scene.visible_evidence: At seg2:mid (t=19.95s) and seg2:end (t=23.38s) two category labels and their values occupy the identical baseline and are composited over one another — 'AI over a human for a serious talk 33%' and 'Shared personal info with an AI compa' overlap letter-on-letter and neither can be read; the label row is also clipped by the left edge and the bottom two-thirds of the frame is empty.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The lollipop layout places every series label at one fixed y with no measured width or collision/stagger logic, so labels collapse onto each other and overflow the left margin; the two stems are crammed into the right quarter leaving the rest of the frame dead.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Lay the two comparisons out with measured, non-overlapping labels fully inside the safe area (stagger or anchor each label to its own stem), spread the stems across the frame width, and let the 33% vs 25% difference be demonstrated by the marks rather than by text that has to be decoded.
